purpose: Freeze an observation-only, eliminative audit that reports the first pipeline layer at which sealed Stage B rotation-only residual leakage is visibly inconsistent with the frozen layer gate.
claim_ceiling: CONTROLLED_GENERATOR_INTERNAL_MECHANISM_LOCALIZATION_ONLY; FIRST_VISIBLE_LAYER_IS_NOT_CAUSAL_IDENTIFICATION; NO R3 REPAIR, PERFORMANCE, REAL_SCENE, ANDROID, PRODUCT, DANGER OR SAFETY CLAIM

estimand.primary: For each sealed cluster, the earliest ordered layer whose predeclared native audit primitive fails while every required earlier layer passes and the unchanged final R3 absolute leakage boundary remains failed.
estimand.signed_absolute_separation: Signed response and absolute leakage are separately stored and aggregated; abs(median(signed)) is forbidden as an absolute-leakage substitute.
estimand.multiplicity: No pooled confirmatory p-value and no pair-level inference; eight per-cluster routes are descriptive eliminative audit outcomes.

audit.canonical_json: UTF-8, sorted keys, compact separators, LF, finite numbers only

final.three_pair: three consecutive evaluable strict triggers; abstention resets

observation_primitives.inputs: sealed source geometry, K, world_from_camera poses, previous-frame initial feature sites before tracking
records: source material identity and depth at each site
exact current projection of the same material point
H-inverse aligned current coordinate
aligned-minus-previous coordinate residual in pixels
source-known ordinary-least-squares 3x3-cell signed expansion and absolute leakage
observation_primitives.gate: max homogeneous round-trip residual <= 1e-9 px AND cluster source-known absolute P90 <= 0.01/s
observation_primitives.abstain: missing/nonfinite geometry, material identity ambiguity, or source-known cell support below the unchanged local-fit support gates

observation_primitives.inputs: unchanged warped current gray image and unchanged warped current valid mask
records: inverse-map coordinate round-trip residual in pixels
signed and absolute normalized gray residual on common support
interior absolute gray residual P50/P90/P99
warp overlap fraction
observation_primitives.interior: common-valid pixels with Chebyshev distance > 10 px from image edge or invalid-mask boundary
observation_primitives.gate: coordinate round-trip P99 <= 1e-6 px AND interior normalized absolute gray residual P90 <= 1/255 AND overlap >= 0.75
observation_primitives.abstain: interior support below 75% of previous-valid pixels or nonfinite primitive

observation_primitives.inputs: previous valid mask, warped current valid mask, fixed boundary-distance strata
records: mask overlap and attrition
boundary-ring and interior pixel counts
boundary-ring and interior normalized gray residual P90
boundary-ring and interior initial/accepted/managed track counts
boundary-ring and interior source-correspondence track-error expansion
observation_primitives.boundary_ring: common-valid pixel whose Chebyshev distance is <= 10 px from image edge or either invalid-mask boundary; 10 is floor(21/2) from the unchanged LK window
observation_primitives.gate: interior source-correspondence track-error absolute P90 <= 0.01/s; a boundary-only failure requires boundary absolute P90 > 0.01/s, interior <= 0.01/s, and both strata evaluable
observation_primitives.abstain: either boundary or interior stratum lacks unchanged support; no coverage repair or imputation

observation_primitives.inputs: shared initial features, forward endpoints/status, backward endpoints/status, mask sample, accepted tracks, carried tracks, supplements
records: requested and forward-valid counts
backward-available and FB<=1.0px counts
mask-valid accepted count
accepted endpoint minus source-known aligned endpoint
accepted/managed pre-local-fit source-error signed expansion and absolute leakage
carried/supplement identities and path class
observation_primitives.gate: cluster accepted/managed pre-local-fit source-error absolute P90 <= 0.01/s under unchanged filters
observation_primitives.abstain: track or stratum support below unchanged R3 gates; rejected tracks remain rejected and are not imputed

observation_primitives.inputs: unchanged accepted/managed tracks and unchanged R3 cell/final outputs
records: per-cell tracked support, RANSAC support, hull fraction, design condition, coefficients, residual, evaluability and abstention reason
deterministic float64 OLS audit on the exact R3 consensus support
signed cell expansion and absolute cell leakage
common-cell indices
pair signed median and pair median(abs(cell))
cluster signed P50/P90 and absolute type-7 P90
strict three-pair state with abstention reset
observation_primitives.gate: independent coefficients and final reductions reproduce unchanged R3 within the numeric-representation amendment AND cluster absolute type-7 P90 <= 0.01/s
observation_primitives.abstain: common cells <5 or evaluable pairs/601 <0.75; missing values are never zero-filled

aggregation_and_coverage.cluster_signed: type-7 percentiles over evaluable ordered pair_signed values
aggregation_and_coverage.cluster_absolute: type-7 P90 over evaluable ordered pair_absolute values
coverage_ledgers: initial features to forward-valid to FB-valid to mask-valid accepted tracks
aggregation_and_coverage.coverage_use: Coverage attrition is separately reported by layer and stratum. It may cause abstention but cannot be repaired, pooled away, or treated as a scientific response.

per_cluster_routing.precondition: The unchanged final R3 cluster absolute P90 is >0.01/s and required sealed inputs/hashes/coverage are valid.
rules: If any required input, binding, primitive or coverage gate is unavailable, route NOT_EVALUABLE.
If INPUT_GEOMETRY fails, route LEAKAGE_ALREADY_PRESENT_IN_INPUT_GEOMETRY; downstream signals cannot override it.

If geometry passes and ROTATION_WARP fails on the interior primitive, route LEAKAGE_FIRST_VISIBLE_AT_WARP only when MASK_BOUNDARY and FLOW do not independently fail their source-error primitives; otherwise route MULTIPLE_SOURCES_NOT_SEPARABLE.

If geometry and warp interior pass and the fixed boundary-only condition fails, route LEAKAGE_FIRST_VISIBLE_AT_MASK_BOUNDARY only when interior FLOW passes; otherwise route MULTIPLE_SOURCES_NOT_SEPARABLE.
If geometry, warp and mask-boundary gates pass but the pre-local-fit source-error primitive fails, route LEAKAGE_FIRST_VISIBLE_AT_FLOW.
If every earlier layer passes but local-affine/final fails, route LEAKAGE_FIRST_VISIBLE_AT_LOCAL_FIT.
If incompatible primitives implicate more than one non-nested source or ordering cannot distinguish them, route MULTIPLE_SOURCES_NOT_SEPARABLE.
No route is converted into a causal-source claim and no majority vote across clusters replaces per-cluster routing.

resource_gate.source: 6 GiB successor amendment; historical 8 GiB launch/refill gate is superseded only for successor workloads

stop_rules: Stop before payload access on any binding, identity, input-hash, validator-source, coordinate, unit or parameter drift.
Stop before execution unless an independent preflight receipt is VALID and a separately signed activation decision explicitly authorizes one execution.
Stop immediately on available RAM below 6 GiB before launch/refill, below 4 GiB while all workers are already in flight, sustained paging, worker residue, nonfinite values, or output collision.
Stop fail-closed after the first complete execution; no retry, replacement, reseed, coverage repair or post-response rule change.
After per-cluster routing, do not modify R3. A single-variable candidate requires a new contract, independent calibration and a new Stage B successor; the original Stage B is never rerun.
